faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR NEERI Project Assistant-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the CSIR NEERI Project Assistant-II recruitment is 16th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant-II post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. degree in Computer Science or Chemistry from a recognized university to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant-II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant-II post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant-II role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant-II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant-II position in CSIR NEERI.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official CSIR NEERI website.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the CSIR NEERI Project Assistant-II recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant-II recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by CSIR National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR NEERI).

faq.question: Q10. Where is CSIR NEERI located?
faq.answer: CSIR NEERI is located in Nagpur, Maharashtra, with the pincode 440020.
